turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
Once an order has shipped, the shipping address can no longer be changed. 🙂

Because orders begin processing quickly and ship out promptly, address updates are only possible within the initial 30-minute window after placing the order through your order dashboard. Once it leaves our warehouse, neither you nor our team can modify the destination. Please note that EVRYJEWELS is not responsible for packages that cannot be retrieved if the initial address was incorrect.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
Because all of our sales are final once placed, we are unable to cancel orders, so cancellations and subsequent refunds do not apply. 🙂

If an order happens to be automatically canceled by our security system due to being flagged as potentially fraudulent, you are not actually charged. Any temporary authorization hold on your statement typically clears and disappears within 10 business days.
